title: ATTRACT MODE ON THE TITLE
why: His ask of 2026-10-08: when nobody is playing, the first screen should show gameplay, as old arcade games did. On the title, after 30 seconds with no key, mouse or controller input, a gameplay clip now plays over the whole screen under PRESS ANY KEY, and any input stops it without doing anything else. The clip is one recorded in the game (the next build adds F9 to record), or else a video named attract.mp4 or attract.webm next to the game file, so a clip recorded any other way works too.
now: Leave the title screen alone for 30 seconds and a gameplay clip plays until you press a key.
